item.title: Power2X Acquires Hydrogen Project Developer HyCC To Scale Delivery In The Netherlands And Northwest Europe

The transaction strengthens Power2X’s position in clean fuels and feedstocks for industrial customers in the Netherlands and Germany as projects transition from early-stage development to large-scale delivery.
